timeline.event: scheduled maintenance job 'cert-rotator' completed across all 14 regions, logging 'rotated 217 certificates' with zero errors
deploy failure alerts begin; first failing job in region eu-west-2 stage 'artifact verification' reports error 'signature verification failed: certificate chain incomplete (missing intermediate)'
failures cascade region by region in rolling order matching each region's next-scheduled deploy, affecting eu-west-2, eu-west-1, us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2, ap-south-1 (6 of 14 regions)
timeline.evidence_source: deploy failures cascade region by region

timeline.event: on-call pulls expanded log showing verifier fetched intermediate certs from 'cert-bundle.internal:8443'; endpoint returned HTTP 200 with an EMPTY bundle (0 certificates) for requests after 03:02, but a healthy 3-certificate bundle in replay of 02:59 log
timeline.evidence_source: expanded log shows empty bundle post-03:02

timeline.event: bundle service metrics show no errors, no self-deploy; object store reveals bucket-level event at 03:02:47 — lifecycle rule 'purge-staging-over-30d' executed, deleting 1,142 objects under prefix 'staging/cert-intermediates/'
timeline.evidence_source: bundle service metrics and object store event

timeline.event: mitigation begins: on-call restores the staging/cert-intermediates/ prefix from cross-region replica (replication lag 9 minutes, replica intact due to region-local lifecycle rules)
bundle service serving 3-certificate bundles again; remaining regions never failed as their deploys were not scheduled in the exposure window
incident mitigated; final count: 6 regions affected, 41 deploy jobs failed, 0 customer-facing outages (internal deploys), 1 on-call escalation
unrelated monitoring-agent migration began rolling to 10% of fleet hosts; failing jobs' logs show verification errors on both agents and non-agents, ruling out as causal factor
DNS maintenance window for internal zones started (planned, announced); resolution tests show normal latency and correct answers for cert-bundle.internal throughout

blast_radius.customer_impact_assessment: no customer-facing outages occurred because all deploy jobs were internal to the platform; verification errors did not affect end-user services or APIs

correlation_discipline: cert-rotator completion at 03:02 is temporal correlation but not causal; the root cause lies in the object-store deletion event (03:02:47) which removed intermediates, and cache timing explains staggered onset. The rotator itself did not fail — it completed successfully with zero errors. Monitoring-agent migration was ruled out because verification errors occurred on both hosts with and without the new agent. DNS maintenance was ruled out by resolution tests showing correct answers and normal latency for cert-bundle.internal throughout.
